findings.text: Advisory, as filed (questions 1 and 6). `mayRunStaged` and `binOwner` live in `report.ts`, the module of sentences, and `reconcile.ts` imports them from there. The dependency stays inside `src/update/`. Moving them to a leaf would be cleaner, but no unit fails to change for a single reason.

Advisory, as filed (questions 1 and 3). `gather` is described as a read but also deletes `WIZARDINGCODE_MEM_HANDED` from the environment. Its name does not say the opposite of what it does, so this is advisory under the rubric.

Advisory, as filed (questions 2 and 3). The one-line reduction of an error to its first line appears as `firstLine`, as `said` and inline in reconcile.ts. That is boilerplate-sized duplication, and `said` could be named more sharply.

Advisory, as filed (question 10). The header says `updateLine` and `agentsLine` are the only writers of these sentences, but `reportOrReason` and update.ts also write lines for the person. The comment is stale; the behaviour is not wrong.

Upheld (question 1). The first part of AC-32: `status`, `doctor` and `update` must not run the staged file as root or from a folder another user owns. The tests cover `mayRunStaged`'s table (line 173) and `agentsLine` given a hand-built `refused: true` (line 177). No test reaches `stagedFacts` (src/update/report.ts:55-66), where the guard is applied. I checked: no test file references `stagedFacts`. If it always ran `stagedVersion` with `refused: false`, every test would still pass. A behaviour criterion has no test that fails on reversion.

Upheld (question 1). AC-32 says 'a report that cannot be built is said with its reason in `status`, as in `doctor`'. `reportOrReason` is tested alone (update-report.test.ts:193). Every `status` case in this describe block (lines 236-280) builds a report that succeeds. If status.ts went back to swallowing the error silently, no test would fail.
Advisory, as filed. The `realpathSync` step in `gather` is still not exercised. It is deferred in docs/real-use/findings.md, and AC-23's `decide` rule is tested on its inputs.
Advisory, as filed. AC-31 is pinned only through `status`. This is a gap in breadth, deferred.
Advisory, as filed (questions 5 and 6). The test asserts the observable hand-over, not that `handOver` is the function used. Deferred.
Advisory, as filed. Temporary folders are not removed. This is fixture hygiene, deferred.

Advisory, as filed. Round 1's defect is closed. I checked diff lines 1036-1053: `stagedFacts` asks `mayRunStaged` (no root, and the folder must be the effective user's) before `stagedVersion`, and reports `refused` otherwise.
Advisory, as filed. The request and the state-file boundary remain sound: the URL is fixed, redirects are not followed, `Location` is matched strictly and `readState` re-validates every field.

Advisory, as filed (public-api, question 6). `status --json` gains `update` (with `stagedPath` and `refused`), and a store error now writes JSON to stdout with exit 1. The change is additive and documented, and no field is removed or changed.
Advisory, debt (outside the change). `stageBinary` still runs the staged file's `--version` with no root or owner check. Recorded as deferred.
Advisory, as filed. When the data directory cannot be written, one log entry is written per turn and nothing caps the repetition. The spec's Limits state it, and it is recorded as deferred.
Advisory, as filed. A hung staged binary can delay a command by up to about 20 s. This is a stated limit, bounded in the code.
Advisory, debt (outside the change). `stageBinary` (and so `install`) still runs `--version` with no root or owner check. Recorded as deferred.
Advisory, debt (outside the change). Two writers can collide on the fixed `<target>.new` name. Recorded as deferred.
Advisory, debt (outside the change). `spawnCli` does not pass on the preload's `WIZARDINGCODE_MEM_UPDATE=off`. Recorded as deferred.

Advisory, as filed. The staged-run rule lives in `report.ts`, so the hand-over loads the report's imports to read one rule. A leaf such as `src/update/staged.ts` would keep the rule apart. No boundary of AC-27 is crossed, and `main.ts` still loads `reconcile.ts` only through a dynamic import.
Advisory, as filed (question 4). The rollback for a wrong notice is stated but has never been run, and the runbook says so.
Advisory, as filed (question 1). The suite stays offline through the preload and the helpers' copied environment, and CI stays offline through `mode()` returning `ci`. Recorded as deferred.
Advisory, debt (outside the change). A plain release on an older line becomes GitHub's latest and moves the notice back. The runbook names the manual correction.
